extDescription.message: Inspect any React app: identify components on hover, jump to source, visualize re-renders. MUI-aware, any styling.

popupToggleInspect.message: Toggle inspect mode on this tab

popupToggleTree.message: Toggle component tree on this tab

hintEnableSite.message: For deployed/production sites (not just localhost). Grants access to this site and starts inspecting right away — no reload needed.

hintAllSites.message: Grant once and it works on every site with no per-site prompts. Revoke anytime with the same button. This extension only reads the page — it never sends data, stores page content, or runs remote code.

permError.message: The permission request didn't go through — close this popup, open it again, and press the button once more.

siteUnavailable.message: This page (non-http/https or unknown URL) can't be enabled.

injectError.message: Couldn't start on this page — reload the page and try again.

labelMuiSkip.message: Skip MUI internals and jump to your own code

labelShowVarNames.message: Prefer CSS variable names over raw values

tipShowVarNames.message: ON: when a value is declared with a CSS variable (e.g. var(--text)), the badge shows the variable name so you can verify the UI uses your design tokens. OFF: always shows the raw value (#hex/px). Only same-origin CSS variables can be read precisely; others fall back to the raw value.

tipAutoTheme.message: ON: when the page uses MUI, the theme (palette / spacing / border radius / font sizes) is read from its ThemeProvider and merged into token matching — no JSON pasting needed. Pasted tokens take precedence. OFF: only pasted tokens are used.

tipMuiSkip.message: ON: clicking jumps to the line in YOUR JSX (e.g. where you wrote <Card>), not into MUI library files. OFF: jumps into MUI's internal files.

tipOpenEditor.message: Click an element to open its source line in your editor. Dev build only — production builds have no source location, so this has no effect there.

tipBadgeDetail.message: How much the hover badge shows. Compact = name + location; Standard = + design info (color/spacing); Detailed = everything. Design info always shows on production sites.

tipRecordKey.message: In render-visualization mode, this key starts/stops recording re-renders (default R). It only works while render mode is ON.

tipPathMappings.message: If clicking doesn't open the file, map the dev-server path to your local absolute path (e.g. /src=/Users/you/app/src), one per line.

hintTarget.message: Localhost works out of the box; enable any other site in “Use on this site” above. Settings save automatically.

hintConfigureShortcuts.message: Opens chrome://extensions/shortcuts to remap Alt+Shift+I to any keys.

inspectOn.message: Inspect ON — hover to inspect, Esc to exit. Click: editor / Alt+Click: rendered-by tree / ↑↓: parent/child

inspectOnSafe.message: Inspect ON — no dev build detected, safe mode (names only / Esc to exit)

jumpUnresolved.message: Could not resolve source location (React 19 may need the Babel source plugin)

jumpProd.message: Source jump is unavailable on production builds

editorLinkOff.message: Editor link is off (toggle it in the popup). Alt+Click still opens the rendered-by tree.

sourceMinified.message: bundled output · run a dev build to jump

renderOn.message: Render viz ON — re-rendered elements flash (blue→red = more frequent) / R: record / toggle again to exit

renderOnNoDev.message: Render viz ON — no dev build detected, timing unavailable (flash only)

treeOn.message: Component tree ON — hover a row to highlight, hover the page to locate it. Esc to close

treeOnSafe.message: Component tree ON — no dev build detected, names are estimated

recordStart.message: Recording — interact to trigger re-renders, press R to stop and see the ranking

statsColsSupported.message: Hover a row for why it re-rendered (state / props / parent)

statsColsUnsupported.message: Production build: render counts and causes are exact, timings need a dev build

statsWastedHint.message: wasted = re-rendered by a parent with identical props → React.memo candidate

statsCopied.message: Report copied — paste it into your AI assistant to start the analysis

statsCopyFail.message: Copy failed — clipboard is unavailable on this page

themeTokensLoaded.message: MUI theme detected — {colors} colors / {sizes} sizes added as tokens
themeTokensLoaded.description: Toast when the MUI theme is auto-extracted (FR-14). {colors}/{sizes} are counts.

labelTokens.message: Paste tokens JSON (Figma Variables / W3C / Tokens Studio)

hintTokens.message: Export your Figma Variables (or any design-tokens JSON) and paste it here. While inspecting, each color/spacing chip shows the matching token name — or flags it as a stray value with the nearest token. Works on production sites.

tokensError.message: Invalid JSON — paste the exported tokens file as-is
